published_prior_art.cite: Bai2023WhyRandomize gives group averaging for a fixed assignment/estimator; SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026 and Hull2026BoundedOutcomes solve the unrestricted class.
SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026 and Hull2026BoundedOutcomes establish the unrestricted Bernoulli/nonlinear-estimator endpoint.
Kallus2021Optimality establishes mixed-design relevance for a fixed-estimator variance criterion, not this all-estimator hard-budget separation.
The closest unrestricted minimax papers give the rho=1 endpoint, not the hard pair-discordance interpolation or optimizer concentration.
HarshawSavjeSpielmanZhang2024 and SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026 do not characterize a measure-valued first-order face of all-estimator minimax designs.
SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026 has a scalar reduced-model Airy expansion, not exact-minimizer accumulation-set selection on a pair-orbit design face.
LiSpertusStark2025 supplies exact composite-null ATE inversion for independently randomized strata; the claimed extension is to correlated orbit laws.

soundness_flags.label: def:observation-kernel and all results depending on K
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed coefficient formula does not condition on assignment orbit n: it sums over all four local assignments in every pair with no assignment-margin marker/coefficient, so division by C_n does not make K a stochastic kernel; tau_h is also used throughout but never defined from h.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 computational-size claim
soundness_flags.one_line: At s=J, |H_{J,s}|=binom(J+9,9), |O_J|=binom(J+9,9), and |N_J|=binom(J+2,2), so the displayed full K array has order J^20 entries, not O(J^18).

soundness_flags.label: ass:armwise-discordance-budget
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited administrative categories and eligibility rules do not by themselves certify agreement of unobserved potential outcomes under both arms, so the asserted known hard budget lacks a credible operational regime or validation route.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2.1 establishes uniform group randomization for a fixed assignment vector and invariant estimator; the conclusion leaves more complicated joint design-estimator settings for future work.
The paper studies minimax variance with conditional means in a structured set, shows mixed-strategy randomization can be required, and proposes an inference-constrained mixed-strategy design.

The unrestricted binary finite-population problem reduces to a binomial experiment indexed by (p,q,r); Bernoulli(1/2) with a nonlinear posterior-mean rule is minimax, with an Airy second-order expansion.
Over all measurable estimators for bounded schedules, independent assignment is minimax and the generally nonlinear optimal estimator is characterized by a finite minimax program.
The paper establishes maximal precision of a matched-pair design among stratified randomization schemes treating units with probability one half.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(548), 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The Gram--Schmidt Walk paper gives finite-sample MSE/tail guarantees, asymptotic results, and inference methods for its balance--robustness design.
Under design-unbiased estimation of bounded finite-population totals, pairwise independent inclusion indicators characterize attainment of the sharp minimax bound.
The paper gives exact matched-pair binary-outcome inference under within-pair coin flips using a boundary-corner characterization and logarithmically many binomial-tail calculations.
The paper gives O(log n) exact-interval computation for balanced Bernoulli and matched-pair designs, with a separate O(n^2) extension to general Bernoulli designs.

The paper studies exact/conservative binary ATE inference in strata randomized independently by within-stratum simple random sampling and includes overall-ATE permutation-test inversion maximizing over compatible tables.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the orbit kernel by an assignment-marked generating function, take the coefficient fixing n as well as o, define tau_h explicitly from the pair-type histogram, and correct the complexity claim to O(J^20) unless a genuine sufficient-statistic compression proves O(J^18).

Make the discordance certificate operational: specify a concrete pre-treatment data source or design regime that logically bounds both armwise potential-outcome discordances, or recast the project as sensitivity analysis over an unverified s rather than a practitioner-known budget.

After repairing the finite experiment, compute exact optimal faces for J=2,3,4 and state a concrete critical scaling subproblem for s_J-J/2; use its observed contact pattern to sharpen the OEQ handle into a falsifiable local variational target.

recommended_next_step: Revise the reduced experiment and practical meaning of the hard budget before Stage 0; then recheck the phase and optimizer-face claims against the corrected kernel.
